div.div: مَغْضُورٌ A man enjoying a pleasant life: (S:) blest; fortunate; abounding in good, or advantage, or utility: (Msb, K:) or in a state of ease, comfort, and affluence; or of plenty, or prosperity; (O, K, TA;) and of happiness: (TA:) as also ↓ مُغْضِرٌ : (K, TA:) pl. of the former مَغَاضِيرٌ, as well as مَغْضُورُونَ. (TA.)
From An Arabic-English Lexicon (Edward William Lane)
